Internal Assessment 1: Electrical Machines

Answer all questions.

1\. A 4-pole, 50 Hz induction motor runs at 1440 rpm. The slip is

(A) 2%

(B) 4%

(C) 5%

(D) 6%

Answer: B

2\. The RMS value of $v(t) = V_m \sin \omega t$ is given by

(A) $\frac{V_m}{\sqrt{2}}$ (B) $\frac{V_m}{2}$ (C) $\sqrt{2} V_m$ (D) $V_m$

Ans: (a)
